description: E05 (ffw-xcz) boot-hook and rollback model: hand-written (transition, fault) matrix, the six invariants and predicate separation with planted defects, and evidence/CLI/hygiene cases, run through the shared run-suite.

E05.AC1.text: Unit/property/contract coverage: hook ordering, permissions, persistence, stop-marker and watchdog semantics, repeated start and missing executable per image; unknown semantics resolve to UNQUALIFIED with a named blocker.

E05.AC2.text: Offline boot-state traces inject a fault at every transition and show one audio owner or a fail-muted/unqualified state; absence of a recovery path is a failed case.

E05.AC3.text: Every transition and rollback logs its exact reason; hook presence never establishes readable, executed, started, writable or installed.

E05.AC4.text: Named cases under tests/e05 with hand-written expected outcomes, a scripts/e2e/e05 entry point, boundary and error cases, command and result receipts, and the invariant-to-case map in docs/contracts/e05.md.

E05.AC5.text: Offline only: the model and checker import no network or process module, write no file, and carry no private identifiers or write-primitive vocabulary.
